drafts.title: The Kitchen Intrusion
drafts.reasoning: This scene sets up the initial conflict by highlighting Ursula’s need for recognition and control, while introducing Hitler's erratic behavior through their interactions.
drafts.scene: Modern Kitchen in an Underground Bunker

dialogue.line: Miles! Owen! Listen to me, you idiots! I deserve that exec producer credit just as much as you do!
(screaming) Kyle, are they even listening? Do they know who is in charge here?
And don't look at him like that, Hitler. You're running out of time.
Time! Time! How can there be a shortage of time when I'm practically immortal now?
Look at yourself, Miles. Aren't we both stuck with this ridiculous kitchen setup? At least I’m still getting younger every minute.
What did you say about being ‘younger’? I demand results, not excuses.
Alright, alright… let’s see what the serum does next. (injects herself) Ahhh, perfection.
